source_en: Find the value of $ {a} + {b} $.
translation: Wara valeur ti $ {a} + {b} $.

source_en: Add the digits in the same place.
translation: Zia chiffre ti ndo oko together (addition).

source_en: When a place adds up to 10 or more, carry to the next place.
translation: Tongana ndo oko asi 10 wala ahon, zia retenue na ndo so alondo.

source_en: Find the value of $ {a} - {b} $.
translation: Wara valeur ti $ {a} - {b} $.

source_en: Subtract the digits in the same place.
translation: Sara soustraction ti chiffre ti ndo oko.

source_en: When you cannot subtract, borrow 10 from the next place.
translation: Tongana mo lingbi ti kaa ape, mo yeke emprunter 10 na ndo so alondo.

source_en: Find the value of $ {a} \times {b} $.
translation: Wara valeur ti $ {a} \times {b} $.

source_en: Think of the times table or of equal groups.
translation: Bâ table de multiplication wala agroupe so ayeke pëpe-pëpe.

source_en: For bigger numbers, multiply place by place and add the parts.
translation: Na anombre so ayeke ngangu, sara multiplication ndo na ndo, na mo zia akete mbage together.

source_en: Find the value of $ {a} \div {b} $.
translation: Wara valeur ti $ {a} \div {b} $.

source_en: Use the times table of the divisor backwards.
translation: Sara na table de multiplication ti diviseur, mo kiri na peko.

source_en: Find what number times {b} gives {a}.
translation: Wara nombre so mo multiplier lo na {b} ti wara {a}.

source_en: What is the digit in the tens place of ${n}$? (digits only)
translation: Chiffre ti ndo ti dizaine na yâ ti ${n}$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: It is the second digit from the right.
translation: Ni ayeke deuxième chiffre na mbage ti droite.

source_en: Find the digit just to the left of the ones place.
translation: Wara chiffre so ayeke na gauche ti ndo ti unité.

source_en: The tens digit of {n} is {ans}.
translation: Chiffre ti dizaine ti {n} ayeke {ans}.

source_en: Find the rule and write the missing number: ${list}, \square$
translation: Wara règle, na sö nombre so akpe: ${list}, \square$

source_en: Find the difference between neighbouring numbers.
translation: Wara différence na popo ti anombre so ayeke vandaa.

source_en: The numbers grow or shrink by the same amount each step.
translation: Anombre ayeke monter wala descendre na même quantité na chaque pas.

source_en: The difference between neighbours is {d}, so □={ans}.
translation: Différence na popo ti anombre ayeke {d}, tongaso □={ans}.

source_en: How many metres is {v} km? (digits only)
translation: {v} km ayeke mètre boni? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: 1 km is 1000 m.
translation: 1 km ayeke 1000 m.

source_en: Multiply {v} by 1000.
translation: Multiplier {v} na 1000.

source_en: {v}×1000={ans}, so it is {ans} m.
translation: {v}×1000={ans}, tongaso ayeke {ans} m.

source_en: How many millilitres is {v} L? (digits only)
translation: {v} L ayeke millilitre boni? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: 1 L is 1000 mL.
translation: 1 L ayeke 1000 mL.

source_en: Multiply {v} by 1000.
translation: Multiplier {v} na 1000.

source_en: {v}×1000={ans}, so it is {ans} mL.
translation: {v}×1000={ans}, tongaso ayeke {ans} mL.

source_en: The radius of a circle is {r} cm. How many cm is its diameter? (cm)
translation: Rayon ti cercle ayeke {r} cm. Diamètre ti lo ayeke cm boni? (cm)

source_en: The diameter is twice the radius.
translation: Diamètre ayeke ûse ti rayon.

source_en: Multiply the radius by 2.
translation: Multiplier rayon na 2.

source_en: {r}×2={ans}, so the diameter is {ans} cm.
translation: {r}×2={ans}, tongaso diamètre ayeke {ans} cm.

source_en: Two angles of a triangle are {a}° and {b}°. How many degrees is the third angle? (degrees)
translation: Angle ûse ti triangle ayeke {a}° na {b}°. Angle ti ôta ayeke degré boni? (degré)

source_en: The three angles of a triangle add up to 180°.
translation: Angle ôta ti triangle asara 180° together.

source_en: Subtract the two known angles from 180.
translation: Soustraire angle ûse so mo hinga na 180.

source_en: 180-{a}-{b}={ans}, so it is {ans}°.
translation: 180-{a}-{b}={ans}, tongaso ayeke {ans}°.

source_en: What number is made of {a} ten-thousands and {b} thousands? (digits only)
translation: Nombre so asara dizaine de mille {a} na mille {b} ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: {a} ten-thousands is {a}0000.
translation: Dizaine de mille {a} ayeke {a}0000.

source_en: {b} thousands is {b}000. Add them.
translation: Mille {b} ayeke {b}000. Zia ni together.

source_en: {a} ten-thousands and {b} thousands make {ans}.
translation: Dizaine de mille {a} na mille {b} asara {ans}.

source_en: Find the value of $\frac{{a}}{{b}} + \frac{{c}}{{d}}$. (a decimal is fine, or a fraction written like 3/4)
translation: Wara valeur ti $\frac{{a}}{{b}} + \frac{{c}}{{d}}$. (décimal alingbi, wala fraction so mo sö tongana 3/4)

source_en: Rewrite the fractions with a common denominator.
translation: Sö fraction na même dénominateur.

source_en: Add the numerators.
translation: Zia anumérateur together.

source_en: $\frac{{a}}{{b}}+\frac{{c}}{{d}}=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$.
translation: $\frac{{a}}{{b}}+\frac{{c}}{{d}}=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$.

source_en: Find the value of $\frac{{a}}{{b}} \div {c}$. (a decimal is fine, or a fraction written like 3/4)
translation: Wara valeur ti $\frac{{a}}{{b}} \div {c}$. (décimal alingbi, wala fraction so mo sö tongana 3/4)

source_en: Dividing a fraction by a whole number multiplies its denominator by that number.
translation: Diviser fraction na nombre entier ayeke multiplier dénominateur ti ni na nombre so.

source_en: Simplify after you calculate.
translation: Simplifier na peko ti calcul.

source_en: $\frac{{a}}{{b}}\div{c}=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$.
translation: $\frac{{a}}{{b}}\div{c}=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$.

source_en: Find the value of $ {a} \times {b} $.
translation: Wara valeur ti $ {a} \times {b} $.

source_en: Ignore the decimal point and multiply as whole numbers.
translation: Kiri virgule na peko, na sara multiplication tongana anombre entier.

source_en: Then put the decimal point back, with as many decimal places as the factors had.
translation: Na peko, zia virgule ti décimal, na même nombre ti chiffre décimal so ayeke na afacteur together.

source_en: A rectangle is {w} cm wide and {h} cm tall. What is its area in cm²? (digits only)
translation: Rectangle ayeke na largeur {w} cm na hauteur {h} cm. Aire ti lo ayeke cm² boni? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The area of a rectangle is width × height.
translation: Aire ti rectangle ayeke largeur × hauteur.

source_en: Multiply the two side lengths.
translation: Multiplier longueur ti akote ûse.

source_en: {w}×{h}={ans}, so the area is {ans} cm².
translation: {w}×{h}={ans}, tongaso aire ayeke {ans} cm².

source_en: A rectangle is {w} cm wide and {h} cm tall. How long is its perimeter in cm? (cm)
translation: Rectangle ayeke na largeur {w} cm na hauteur {h} cm. Périmètre ti lo ayeke cm boni? (cm)

source_en: The perimeter is the sum of the four sides.
translation: Périmètre ayeke somme ti akote osio.

source_en: You can use (width + height) × 2.
translation: Mo lingbi ti sara na (largeur + hauteur) × 2.

source_en: ({w}+{h})×2={ans}, so the perimeter is {ans} cm.
translation: ({w}+{h})×2={ans}, tongaso périmètre ayeke {ans} cm.

source_en: Write $\frac{{a}}{{b}}$ as a percentage. (digits only)
translation: Sö $\frac{{a}}{{b}}$ tongana pourcentage. (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: A percentage is the ratio multiplied by 100.
translation: Pourcentage ayeke rapport × 100.

source_en: You can also rewrite the fraction with denominator 100.
translation: Mo lingbi ti sö fraction na dénominateur 100.

source_en: $\frac{{a}}{{b}}\times100={ans}$, so it is {ans}%.
translation: $\frac{{a}}{{b}}\times100={ans}$, tongaso ayeke {ans}%.

source_en: In the proportion ${a} : {b} = \square : {d}$, what number goes in the box? (digits only)
translation: Na yâ ti proportion ${a} : {b} = \square : {d}$, nombre nye ayeke na yâ ti carré? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: In a proportion, the product of the outer terms equals the product of the inner terms.
translation: Na yâ ti proportion, produit ti anombre ti dehors ayeke même na produit ti anombre ti dedans.

source_en: Solve □ × {b} = {a} × {d}.
translation: Résoudre □ × {b} = {a} × {d}.
□×{b}={a}×{d}, tongaso □={ans}.

source_en: Write this decimal as a percentage: ${d}$ (digits only)
translation: Sö décimal so tongana pourcentage: ${d}$ (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Multiply the decimal by 100 to get a percentage.
translation: Multiplier décimal na 100 ti wara pourcentage.

source_en: Move the decimal point two places to the right.
translation: Zia virgule na ndo ti ûse na droite.

source_en: {d}×100={ans}, so it is {ans}%.
translation: {d}×100={ans}, tongaso ayeke {ans}%.

source_en: One edge of a cube is {a} cm. What is its volume in cm³? (digits only)
translation: Oko arête ti cube ayeke {a} cm. Volume ti lo ayeke cm³ boni? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The volume of a cube is edge × edge × edge.
translation: Volume ti cube ayeke arête × arête × arête.

source_en: Multiply {a} by itself three times.
translation: Multiplier {a} na lo mveni ôta ngbâ.

source_en: {a}×{a}×{a}={ans}, so the volume is {ans} cm³.
translation: {a}×{a}×{a}={ans}, tongaso volume ayeke {ans} cm³.

source_en: A cuboid is {a} cm long, {b} cm wide and {c} cm high. What is its volume in cm³? (cm³)
translation: Pavé ayeke na longueur {a} cm, largeur {b} cm na hauteur {c} cm. Volume ti lo ayeke cm³ boni? (cm³)

source_en: The volume of a cuboid is length × width × height.
translation: Volume ti pavé ayeke longueur × largeur × hauteur.

source_en: Multiply all three lengths.
translation: Multiplier longueur ôta kûê.

source_en: {a}×{b}×{c}={ans}, so the volume is {ans} cm³.
translation: {a}×{b}×{c}={ans}, tongaso volume ayeke {ans} cm³.

source_en: A circle has a radius of {r} cm. How long is its circumference in cm? (use $3.14$ for pi) (cm)
translation: Cercle ayeke na rayon {r} cm. Circonférence ti lo ayeke cm boni? (sara na $3.14$ ti pi) (cm)

source_en: The circumference is diameter × pi.
translation: Circonférence ayeke diamètre × pi.

source_en: The diameter is twice the radius.
translation: Diamètre ayeke ûse ti rayon.

source_en: {r}×2×3.14={ans}, so it is {ans} cm.
translation: {r}×2×3.14={ans}, tongaso ayeke {ans} cm.

source_en: A circle has a radius of {r} cm. What is its area in cm²? (use $3.14$ for pi) (cm²)
translation: Cercle ayeke na rayon {r} cm. Aire ti lo ayeke cm² boni? (sara na $3.14$ ti pi) (cm²)

source_en: The area is radius × radius × pi.
translation: Aire ayeke rayon × rayon × pi.

source_en: Square the radius, then multiply by 3.14.
translation: Sara carré ti rayon, na peko multiplier na 3.14.

source_en: {r}×{r}×3.14={ans}, so the area is {ans} cm².
translation: {r}×{r}×3.14={ans}, tongaso aire ayeke {ans} cm².

source_en: The mean of {n} numbers is {m}. What is the sum of these {n} numbers? (digits only)
translation: Moyenne ti anombre {n} ayeke {m}. Somme ti anombre {n} so ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: mean = sum ÷ count.
translation: moyenne = somme ÷ nombre.

source_en: So sum = mean × count.
translation: Tongaso somme = moyenne × nombre.

source_en: When $x={x}$, what is the value of ${expr}$?
translation: Tongana $x={x}$, valeur ti ${expr}$ ayeke nye?

source_en: Put the given number in place of x.
translation: Zia nombre so a mû na ndo ti x.

source_en: Multiply first, then add or subtract.
translation: Sara multiplication kozo, na peko zia wala soustraire.

source_en: Putting in x={x} gives ${expr}={ans}$.
translation: Tongana a zia x={x}, a wara ${expr}={ans}$.

source_en: Solve the linear equation ${eq}$ (find x).
translation: Résoudre équation ${eq}$ (wara x).

source_en: Add or subtract the same number on both sides to leave the x term alone.
translation: Zia wala soustraire même nombre na akote ûse ti zia terme ti x tongana oko.

source_en: Then divide both sides by the number in front of x.
translation: Na peko diviser akote ûse na nombre so ayeke na ndo ti x.

source_en: From ${eq}$ we get x={ans}.
translation: Na ${eq}$ a wara x={ans}.

source_en: In $x^{{a}} \times x^{{b}} = x^{\square}$, what number goes in the box? (digits only)
translation: Na yâ ti $x^{{a}} \times x^{{b}} = x^{\square}$, nombre nye ayeke na yâ ti carré? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: When the bases are equal, add the exponents.
translation: Tongana base ayeke même, zia aexposant together.

source_en: Calculate {a}+{b}.
translation: Sara calcul ti {a}+{b}.

source_en: {a}+{b}={ans}, so □={ans}.
translation: {a}+{b}={ans}, tongaso □={ans}.

source_en: In $(x^{{a}})^{{b}} = x^{\square}$, what number goes in the box? (digits only)
translation: Na yâ ti $(x^{{a}})^{{b}} = x^{\square}$, nombre nye ayeke na yâ ti carré? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: A power of a power multiplies the exponents.
translation: Puissance ti puissance ayeke multiplier aexposant.

source_en: Calculate {a}×{b}.
translation: Sara calcul ti {a}×{b}.

source_en: {a}×{b}={ans}, so □={ans}.
translation: {a}×{b}={ans}, tongaso □={ans}.

source_en: What is the largest integer $x$ that satisfies $x+{a} < {b}$? (digits only)
translation: Nombre entier ti kota ahon so $x$ asara $x+{a} < {b}$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Subtract the same number from both sides to find the range of x.
translation: Soustraire même nombre na akote ûse ti wara intervalle ti x.

source_en: x must be less than the value you find; that value itself is not included.
translation: x ayeke kete ahon valeur so mo wara; valeur ni mveni ayeke yâ ape.

source_en: x<{bound}, so the largest integer is {ans}.
translation: x<{bound}, tongaso nombre entier ti kota ahon ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What is the slope of the line through the points $({x1},\,{y1})$ and $({x2},\,{y2})$? (digits only)
translation: Pente ti droite so ayeke gue na ahaut ti points $({x1},\,{y1})$ na $({x2},\,{y2})$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The slope is (change in y) ÷ (change in x).
translation: Pente ayeke (changement ti y) ÷ (changement ti x).

source_en: Divide the difference of the y-coordinates by the difference of the x-coordinates.
translation: Diviser différence ti coordonnées ti y na différence ti coordonnées ti x.

source_en: How many outcomes are there when {n} coins are tossed together? (digits only)
translation: Résultat boni ayeke na yâ tongana a bi pièces {n} together? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: One coin has 2 outcomes: heads or tails.
translation: Oko pièce ayeke na résultat 2: pile wala face.

source_en: Multiply the number of outcomes of each coin.
translation: Multiplier nombre ti résultat ti chaque pièce.

source_en: 2 multiplied {n} times is {ans}, so there are {ans} outcomes.
translation: 2 multiplier {n} ngbâ ayeke {ans}, tongaso résultat {ans} ayeke.

source_en: One base angle of an isosceles triangle is {b}°. How many degrees is the apex angle? (degrees)
translation: Oko angle ti base ti triangle isocèle ayeke {b}°. Angle ti sommet ayeke degré boni? (degré)

source_en: The two base angles of an isosceles triangle are equal.
translation: Angle ti base ûse ti triangle isocèle ayeke même.

source_en: Subtract both base angles from 180°, the sum of the angles of a triangle.
translation: Soustraire angle ti base ûse na 180°, somme ti angle ti triangle.

source_en: 180-{b}×2={ans}, so the apex angle is {ans}°.
translation: 180-{b}×2={ans}, tongaso angle ti sommet ayeke {ans}°.

source_en: The two sides next to the right angle of a right triangle are {a} cm and {b} cm. How long is the longest side in cm? (cm)
translation: Akote ûse so ayeke vandaa na angle droit ti triangle rectangle ayeke {a} cm na {b} cm. Kote ti kota ahon ayeke cm boni? (cm)

source_en: Pythagorean theorem: (hypotenuse)² = (one side)² + (other side)².
translation: Théorème ti Pythagore: (hypoténuse)² = (oko kote)² + (mbeni kote)².

source_en: Square both sides, add, then take the square root.
translation: Sara carré ti akote ûse, zia together, na peko wara racine carrée.

source_en: ${a}^2+{b}^2={sq}$, so the longest side is {ans} cm.
translation: ${a}^2+{b}^2={sq}$, tongaso kote ti kota ahon ayeke {ans} cm.

source_en: What is the value of $\sqrt{{n}}$? (digits only)
translation: Valeur ti $\sqrt{{n}}$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Find the positive number whose square is {n}.
translation: Wara nombre positif so carré ti lo ayeke {n}.

source_en: Think of the times table.
translation: Bâ table de multiplication.

source_en: ${ans}^2={n}$, so $\sqrt{{n}}={ans}$.
translation: ${ans}^2={n}$, tongaso $\sqrt{{n}}={ans}$.

source_en: If $({fa})({fb}) = x^2+px+q$, what is $p+q$? (digits only)
translation: Tongana $({fa})({fb}) = x^2+px+q$, $p+q$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Use $(x+a)(x+b)=x^2+(a+b)x+ab$.
translation: Sara na $(x+a)(x+b)=x^2+(a+b)x+ab$.

source_en: p is the sum of the two numbers and q is their product.
translation: p ayeke somme ti anombre ûse na q ayeke produit ti ni.

source_en: p={p} and q={q}, so p+q={ans}.
translation: p={p} na q={q}, tongaso p+q={ans}.

source_en: Which is the larger of the two roots of ${eq}$? (digits only)
translation: Racine ti kota na popo ti racine ûse ti ${eq}$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Factorise the left-hand side.
translation: Factoriser mbage ti gauche.

source_en: The roots are the values of x that make a factor zero.
translation: Aracine ayeke avaleur ti x so asara facteur ayeke zéro.

source_en: From ${fact}$ the roots are {roots}, so the larger root is {ans}.
translation: Na ${fact}$ aracine ayeke {roots}, tongaso racine ti kota ayeke {ans}.

source_en: The vertex of the quadratic function $y={expr}$ is $(p,\ q)$. What is $p+q$? (digits only)
translation: Sommet ti fonction quadratique $y={expr}$ ayeke $(p,\ q)$. $p+q$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: In $y=a(x-p)^2+q$ the vertex is $(p,\ q)$.
translation: Na yâ ti $y=a(x-p)^2+q$ sommet ayeke $(p,\ q)$.

source_en: Watch the sign inside the brackets.
translation: Bâ signe na yâ ti parenthèse.

source_en: The vertex is $({p},\ {q})$, so p+q={ans}.
translation: Sommet ayeke $({p},\ {q})$, tongaso p+q={ans}.

source_en: What is the remainder when $P(x)={poly}$ is divided by ${div}$? (digits only)
translation: Reste ayeke nye tongana a diviser $P(x)={poly}$ na ${div}$? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Remainder theorem: the remainder of P(x) divided by x-a is P(a).
translation: Théorème du reste: reste ti P(x) divisé na x-a ayeke P(a).

source_en: Put a in place of x and calculate.
translation: Zia a na ndo ti x na sara calcul.

source_en: By the remainder theorem, P({a})={ans}.
translation: Na théorème du reste, P({a})={ans}.

source_en: What is the sum of the real part and the imaginary part of ${expr}$? (digits only)
translation: Somme ti partie réelle na partie imaginaire ti ${expr}$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Add the real parts together and the imaginary parts together.
translation: Zia aparties réelles together na aparties imaginaires together.

source_en: Treat i like a letter.
translation: Bâ i tongana lettre.

source_en: The real part is {re} and the imaginary part is {im}, so the sum is {ans}.
translation: Partie réelle ayeke {re} na partie imaginaire ayeke {im}, tongaso somme ayeke {ans}.

source_en: In how many ways can you choose {r} of {n} different people and line them up? (digits only)
translation: Na lege boni mo lingbi ti sigi azo {r} na popo ti azo {n} so ayeke tâ mbeni-mbeni na ti zia ala na rang? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Order matters, so this is a permutation.
translation: Ordre ayeke important, tongaso so ayeke permutation.

source_en: Start at {n} and multiply {r} numbers, counting down.
translation: Commencer na {n} na multiplier anombre {r}, mo descendre.

source_en: {calc}={ans}, so there are {ans} ways.
translation: {calc}={ans}, tongaso lege {ans} ayeke.

source_en: In how many ways can you choose {r} of {n} different people when order does not matter? (digits only)
translation: Na lege boni mo lingbi ti sigi azo {r} na popo ti azo {n} so ayeke tâ mbeni-mbeni, tongana ordre ayeke important ape? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Order does not matter, so this is a combination.
translation: Ordre ayeke important ape, tongaso so ayeke combinaison.

source_en: Divide the number of permutations by {r}!.
translation: Diviser nombre ti permutation na {r}!.

source_en: {calc}={ans}, so there are {ans} ways.
translation: {calc}={ans}, tongaso lege {ans} ayeke.

source_en: What is the distance between the points A({x1}, {y1}) and B({x2}, {y2})? (digits only)
translation: Distance na popo ti points A({x1}, {y1}) na B({x2}, {y2}) ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The distance is $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$.
translation: Distance ayeke $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$.

source_en: Square the difference of the x-coordinates and of the y-coordinates, then add.
translation: Sara carré ti différence ti coordonnées ti x na ti y, na zia together.

source_en: What is the radius of the circle $({fx})^2+({fy})^2={r2}$? (digits only)
translation: Rayon ti cercle $({fx})^2+({fy})^2={r2}$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: In $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$, r is the radius.
translation: Na yâ ti $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$, r ayeke rayon.

source_en: The number on the right is r².
translation: Nombre na mbage ti droite ayeke r².

source_en: $r^2={r2}$, so the radius is {ans}.
translation: $r^2={r2}$, tongaso rayon ayeke {ans}.

source_en: How many integers $x$ satisfy the quadratic inequality ${eq}<0$? (digits only)
translation: Anombre entier $x$ boni asara inéquation quadratique ${eq}<0$? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Factorise the left-hand side to find the two roots.
translation: Factoriser mbage ti gauche ti wara aracine ûse.

source_en: Count the integers between the roots; the roots themselves are not included.
translation: Fa anombre entier na popo ti aracine; aracine mveni ayeke yâ ape.

source_en: From ${fact}<0$ we get {r1}<x<{r2}, so there are {ans} integers.
translation: Na ${fact}<0$ a wara {r1}<x<{r2}, tongaso anombre entier {ans} ayeke.

source_en: What is the value of $\log_{{b}} {n}$? (digits only)
translation: Valeur ti $\log_{{b}} {n}$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: $\log_b n=k$ means $b^k=n$.
translation: $\log_b n=k$ ayeke $b^k=n$.

source_en: Count how many times you multiply {b} to get {n}.
translation: Fa ngbâ boni mo multiplier {b} ti wara {n}.

source_en: ${b}^{{ans}}={n}$, so the answer is {ans}.
translation: ${b}^{{ans}}={n}$, tongaso réponse ayeke {ans}.

source_en: Write $\theta=\dfrac{{num}}{{d}}$ (radians) in degrees. (digits only)
translation: Sö $\theta=\dfrac{{num}}{{d}}$ (radian) na degré. (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: $\pi$ radians is 180°.
translation: $\pi$ radian ayeke 180°.

source_en: Put 180° in place of $\pi$.
translation: Zia 180° na ndo ti $\pi$.

source_en: Putting in $\pi=180^\circ$ gives {ans}°.
translation: Tongana a zia $\pi=180^\circ$, a wara {ans}°.

source_en: What is term number {n} of the arithmetic sequence with first term {a} and common difference {d}? (digits only)
translation: Terme numéro {n} ti suite arithmétique so premier terme ayeke {a} na raison ayeke {d} ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The general term is $a_n=a+(n-1)d$.
translation: Terme général ayeke $a_n=a+(n-1)d$.

source_en: Multiply (n-1) by the common difference and add it to the first term.
translation: Multiplier (n-1) na raison na zia na premier terme.

source_en: What is term number {n} of the geometric sequence with first term {a} and common ratio {r}? (digits only)
translation: Terme numéro {n} ti suite géométrique so premier terme ayeke {a} na raison ayeke {r} ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The general term is $a_n=ar^{n-1}$.
translation: Terme général ayeke $a_n=ar^{n-1}$.

source_en: Multiply by the common ratio (n-1) times.
translation: Multiplier na raison (n-1) ngbâ.

source_en: {a} times {r} to the power ({n}-1) is {ans}.
translation: {a} multiplier na {r} puissance ({n}-1) ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What is the value of $\lim_{x\to {a}}({f})$? (digits only)
translation: Valeur ti $\lim_{x\to {a}}({f})$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: For a polynomial, the limit equals the value of the function.
translation: Ti polynôme, limite ayeke même na valeur ti fonction.

source_en: Put {a} in place of x.
translation: Zia {a} na ndo ti x.

source_en: Putting in x={a} gives {ans}.
translation: Tongana a zia x={a}, a wara {ans}.

source_en: If $f(x)={poly}$, what is $f'({a})$? (digits only)
translation: Tongana $f(x)={poly}$, $f'({a})$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Find the derivative, then put {a} in place of x.
translation: Wara dérivée, na peko zia {a} na ndo ti x.

source_en: $f'(x)={deriv}$, so $f'({a})={ans}$.
translation: $f'(x)={deriv}$, tongaso $f'({a})={ans}$.

source_en: What is the value of $\int_{0}^{{b}} ({fx})\,dx$? (digits only)
translation: Valeur ti $\int_{0}^{{b}} ({fx})\,dx$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Find the antiderivative, then calculate (value at the upper limit) - (value at the lower limit).
translation: Wara primitive, na peko sara calcul (valeur na limite ti ndö) - (valeur na limite ti ndo ti gï).

source_en: $\int x\,dx=\frac{x^2}{2}$ and $\int c\,dx=cx$.
translation: $\int x\,dx=\frac{x^2}{2}$ na $\int c\,dx=cx$.

source_en: Putting x={b} into the antiderivative ${anti}$ gives {ans}.
translation: Tongana a zia x={b} na yâ ti primitive ${anti}$, a wara {ans}.

source_en: What is the area enclosed by the curve $y={k}x^2$, the $x$-axis and the line $x={a}$? (digits only)
translation: Aire so courbe $y={k}x^2$, axe ti $x$ na droite $x={a}$ ayeke kpe ni ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The area is the definite integral from 0 to {a}.
translation: Aire ayeke intégrale définie na 0 jusqu'à {a}.

source_en: What is the sum of the infinite geometric series with first term {a} and common ratio ${rtex}$? (a decimal is fine, or a fraction written like 3/4)
translation: Somme ti série géométrique infinie so premier terme ayeke {a} na raison ayeke ${rtex}$ ayeke nye? (décimal alingbi, wala fraction so mo sö tongana 3/4)

source_en: The sum exists when the absolute value of the ratio is less than 1.
translation: Somme ayeke tongana valeur absolue ti raison ayeke kete ahon 1.

source_en: The sum is (first term) ÷ (1 - ratio).
translation: Somme ayeke (premier terme) ÷ (1 - raison).

source_en: If the random variable $X$ follows the binomial distribution $B({n},\ {p})$, what is $E(X)$? (digits only)
translation: Tongana variable aléatoire $X$ alingbi na loi binomiale $B({n},\ {p})$, $E(X)$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The mean of $B(n,\ p)$ is $np$.
translation: Espérance ti $B(n,\ p)$ ayeke $np$.

source_en: Multiply n and p.
translation: Multiplier n na p.

source_en: What is the magnitude $|\vec{a}|$ of the vector $\vec{a}=({x},\ {y})$? (digits only)
translation: Norme $|\vec{a}|$ ti vecteur $\vec{a}=({x},\ {y})$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: Square each component, add, then take the square root.
translation: Sara carré ti chaque composante, zia together, na peko wara racine carrée.

source_en: What is the $x$-coordinate of the focus of the parabola $y^2={c}x$? (digits only)
translation: Coordonnée $x$ ti foyer ti parabole $y^2={c}x$ ayeke nye? (gï chiffre 0-9)

source_en: The focus of $y^2=4px$ is $(p,\ 0)$.
translation: Foyer ti $y^2=4px$ ayeke $(p,\ 0)$.

source_en: Find p from {c}=4p.
translation: Wara p na {c}=4p.

source_en: 4p={c}, so p={ans}.
translation: 4p={c}, tongaso p={ans}.

source_en: For events $A,\ B$, $P(A)={pa}$ and $P(A\cap B)={pab}$. What is $P(B\mid A)$? (write a decimal)
translation: Ti événements $A,\ B$, $P(A)={pa}$ na $P(A\cap B)={pab}$. $P(B\mid A)$ ayeke nye? (sö décimal)

source_en: Conditional probability: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$.
translation: Probabilité conditionnelle: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$.

source_en: Divide the two values.
translation: Diviser avaleur ûse so.

source_en: {pab}÷{pa}={ans}.
translation: {pab}÷{pa}={ans}.

source_en: Which is the biggest of {list}? (digits only)
translation: Nömörö wa ayeke kota ahön na yâ ti {list}? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Compare the numbers one by one.
translation: Sara comparaison ti nömörö oko oko.

source_en: Find the number that stands for the most.
translation: Gi nömörö so ayeke kota ahön.

source_en: The biggest of {list} is {ans}.
translation: Nömörö so ayeke kota ahön na yâ ti {list} ayeke {ans}.

source_en: Which is the smallest of {list}? (digits only)
translation: Nömörö wa ayeke kete ahön na yâ ti {list}? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Compare the numbers one by one.
translation: Sara comparaison ti nömörö oko oko.

source_en: Find the number that stands for the least.
translation: Gi nömörö so ayeke kete ahön.

source_en: The smallest of {list} is {ans}.
translation: Nömörö so ayeke kete ahön na yâ ti {list} ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What number comes right after {n}? (digits only)
translation: Nömörö wa aga mîngi na pekoni ti {n}? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Count the numbers in order.
translation: Bâ nömörö na ndö ti ala.

source_en: Count one more from {n}.
translation: Bâ oko ahön na {n}.

source_en: The number right after {n} is {ans}.
translation: Nömörö so aga na pekoni ti {n} ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What number comes right before {n}? (digits only)
translation: Nömörö wa ayeke na kûê ti {n}? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Count backwards.
translation: Bâ nömörö na pekoni.

source_en: Count one fewer from {n}.
translation: Bâ oko kete na {n}.

source_en: The number right before {n} is {ans}.
translation: Nömörö so ayeke na kûê ti {n} ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What number added to {a} makes 10? (digits only)
translation: Nömörö wa mo yeke tîngbi na {a} ti wara 10? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Subtract {a} from 10.
translation: Zîa {a} na 10.

source_en: Think of your ten fingers.
translation: Bâ ndo ti mo ti oko ti yâ ti ala 10.

source_en: {a}+{ans}=10, so the answer is {ans}.
translation: {a}+{ans}=10, ndö ti ni ayeke {ans}.

source_en: In $\square + {b} = {c}$, what number goes in the box? (digits only)
translation: Na yâ ti $\square + {b} = {c}$, nömörö wa ayeke na yâ ti kare? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Subtract the known number from the total to find □.
translation: Zîa nömörö so mo hinga na yâ ti total ti wara □.

source_en: Calculate {c}-{b}.
translation: Sara calcul ti {c}-{b}.

source_en: {c}-{b}={ans}, so □={ans}.
translation: {c}-{b}={ans}, tongana □={ans}.

source_en: In $ {a} - \square = {c}$, what number goes in the box? (digits only)
translation: Na yâ ti $ {a} - \square = {c}$, nömörö wa ayeke na yâ ti kare? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Subtract the result from the first number to find □.
translation: Zîa résultat na yâ ti premier nömörö ti wara □.

source_en: Calculate {a}-{c}.
translation: Sara calcul ti {a}-{c}.

source_en: {a}-{c}={ans}, so □={ans}.
translation: {a}-{c}={ans}, tongana □={ans}.

source_en: What is the digit in the ones place of ${n}$? (digits only)
translation: Chiffre wa ayeke na place ti unités ti ${n}$? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: It is the digit on the far right.
translation: Ni ayeke chiffre so ayeke na droite mîngi.

source_en: The ones place shows the single units.
translation: Place ti unités amû unités oko oko.

source_en: The ones digit of {n} is {ans}.
translation: Chiffre ti unités ti {n} ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What is the digit in the hundreds place of ${n}$? (digits only)
translation: Chiffre wa ayeke na place ti centaines ti ${n}$? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: It is the third digit from the right.
translation: Ni ayeke troisième chiffre na droite.

source_en: In a three-digit number it is the first digit.
translation: Na yâ ti nömörö ti chiffre ota, ni ayeke premier chiffre.

source_en: The hundreds digit of {n} is {ans}.
translation: Chiffre ti centaines ti {n} ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What number is {k} more than {n}? (digits only)
translation: Nömörö wa ayeke {k} mîngi ahön {n}? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: It is the same as skip-counting up by {k}.
translation: Ni ayeke tongana mo bâ na ndö {k} oko oko.

source_en: Only the digit in one place changes.
translation: Chiffre ti place oko hoto ayeke changé.

source_en: What number is {k} less than {n}? (digits only)
translation: Nömörö wa ayeke {k} kete ahön {n}? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: It is the same as skip-counting down by {k}.
translation: Ni ayeke tongana mo bâ na kûê {k} oko oko.

source_en: Only the digit in one place changes.
translation: Chiffre ti place oko hoto ayeke changé.

source_en: There are {a} in each bundle and {b} bundles. How many are there in all? (digits only)
translation: {a} ayeke na yâ ti paquet oko oko, na paquet ayeke {b}. Ala kûê ayeke asi anga? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Equal groups can be counted with multiplication.
translation: Agroupe so ayeke tî ngangu oko, mo lingbi ti bâ ala na multiplication.

source_en: It is the same as adding {a} a total of {b} times.
translation: Ni ayeke tongana mo bâ {a} ti {b} fois.

source_en: {a}×{b}={ans}, so there are {ans}.
translation: {a}×{b}={ans}, tongana ala kûê ayeke {ans}.

source_en: Three angles of a quadrilateral are {a}°, {b}° and {c}°. How many degrees is the fourth angle? (degrees)
translation: Angle ota ti quadrilatère ayeke {a}°, {b}° na {c}°. Angle ti ota-oko ayeke degré wa? (degré)

source_en: The four angles of a quadrilateral add up to 360°.
translation: Angle osio ti quadrilatère atîngbi na 360°.

source_en: Subtract the three known angles from 360.
translation: Zîa angle ota so mo hinga na yâ ti 360.

source_en: 360-{a}-{b}-{c}={ans}, so it is {ans}°.
translation: 360-{a}-{b}-{c}={ans}, tongana ni ayeke {ans}°.

source_en: Write the fraction $\frac{{a}}{{b}}$ as a decimal. (write a decimal)
translation: Koli fraction $\frac{{a}}{{b}}$ tongana nömörö décimal. (koli nömörö décimal)

source_en: Rewrite the fraction so that the denominator is 10 or 100.
translation: Sara fraction ni nga ti dénominateur ayeke 10 wala 100.

source_en: Or divide the numerator by the denominator.
translation: Wala mo partager numérateur na dénominateur.

source_en: What is the value of $\sqrt{{a}} \times \sqrt{{b}}$? (digits only)
translation: Valeur ti $\sqrt{{a}} \times \sqrt{{b}}$ ayeke nini? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: $\sqrt{a}\times\sqrt{b}=\sqrt{ab}$.
translation: $\sqrt{a}\times\sqrt{b}=\sqrt{ab}$.

source_en: Check whether the product is a square number.
translation: Bâ si produit ni ayeke nömörö carré.

source_en: $\sqrt{{a}\times{b}}=\sqrt{{prod}}={ans}$.
translation: $\sqrt{{a}\times{b}}=\sqrt{{prod}}={ans}$.

source_en: If $({e})^2 = x^2+px+q$, what is $p+q$? (digits only)
translation: Tongana $({e})^2 = x^2+px+q$, $p+q$ ayeke nini? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)
Sara na $(x+a)^2=x^2+2ax+a^2$.

source_en: p is 2a and q is a².
translation: p ayeke 2a na q ayeke a².

source_en: p={p} and q={q}, so p+q={ans}.
translation: p={p} na q={q}, tongana p+q={ans}.

source_en: When ${poly}$ is factorised as $(x+m)(x+n)$, what is the difference between m and n (bigger minus smaller)? (digits only)
translation: Tongana mo factoriser ${poly}$ tongana $(x+m)(x+n)$, différence na ndö ti m na n (kota zîa kete) ayeke nini? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Find two numbers whose sum is the coefficient of x and whose product is the constant term.
translation: Gi nömörö use so somme ti ala ayeke coefficient ti x na produit ti ala ayeke constante.

source_en: After finding them, subtract the smaller from the bigger.
translation: Tongana mo wara ala, zîa kete na yâ ti kota.

source_en: ${poly}=({fm})({fn})$, so the two numbers are {m} and {n}, and the difference is {ans}.
translation: ${poly}=({fm})({fn})$, tongana nömörö use ayeke {m} na {n}, na différence ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What is the value of the discriminant $D=b^2-4ac$ of the quadratic equation ${eq}=0$? (digits only)
translation: Valeur ti discriminant $D=b^2-4ac$ ti équation quadratique ${eq}=0$ ayeke nini? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: The discriminant of $ax^2+bx+c=0$ is $D=b^2-4ac$.
translation: Discriminant ti $ax^2+bx+c=0$ ayeke $D=b^2-4ac$.

source_en: Watch the signs of a, b and c.
translation: Bâ signe ti a, b na c.

source_en: For the quadratic function $y={expr}$, what is $y$ when $x={x}$? (digits only)
translation: Na yâ ti fonction quadratique $y={expr}$, $y$ ayeke nini tongana $x={x}$? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: Put the given value in place of x.
translation: Zîa valeur so ala mû na place ti x.

source_en: Calculate the square first.
translation: Sara calcul ti carré kozo.

source_en: Putting in x={x} gives y={ans}.
translation: Tongana mo zîa x={x}, mo wara y={ans}.

source_en: What is the value of $\log_{{b}} {m} + \log_{{b}} {n}$? (digits only)
translation: Valeur ti $\log_{{b}} {m} + \log_{{b}} {n}$ ayeke nini? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: $\log_b m+\log_b n=\log_b mn$.
translation: $\log_b m+\log_b n=\log_b mn$.

source_en: First find the product {m}×{n}.
translation: Gi kozo produit {m}×{n}.

source_en: $\log_{{b}} ({m}\times{n})=\log_{{b}} {prod}={ans}$.
translation: $\log_{{b}} ({m}\times{n})=\log_{{b}} {prod}={ans}$.

source_en: What is the sum of the first {n} terms of the arithmetic sequence with first term {a} and common difference {d}? (digits only)
translation: Somme ti {n} terme ti kozo ti suite arithmétique so premier terme ayeke {a} na raison ayeke {d} ayeke nini? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: The sum formula is $S_n=\frac{n(2a+(n-1)d)}{2}$.
translation: Formule ti somme ayeke $S_n=\frac{n(2a+(n-1)d)}{2}$.

source_en: You can also find the last term and calculate (first + last) × number of terms ÷ 2.
translation: Mo lingbi nga ti gi terme ti suka na sara calcul (premier + dernier) × nömörö ti terme ÷ 2.

source_en: A geometric sequence has first term {a} and third term {c}. What is the common ratio? (positive, digits only)
translation: Suite géométrique so premier terme ni ayeke {a} na troisième terme ayeke {c}. Raison ayeke nini? (positif, nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: The third term is the first term multiplied by the ratio twice.
translation: Troisième terme ayeke premier terme so mo multiplier na raison ti use.

source_en: From $ar^2=c$ find $r^2$.
translation: Na yâ ti $ar^2=c$, gi $r^2$.

source_en: From {a}×r²={c} we get r²={sq}, so the common ratio is {ans}.
translation: Na yâ ti {a}×r²={c} e wara r²={sq}, tongana raison ayeke {ans}.

source_en: What is the value of $\lim_{x\to {a}}\frac{x^2-{sq}}{{den}}$? (digits only)
translation: Valeur ti $\lim_{x\to {a}}\frac{x^2-{sq}}{{den}}$ ayeke nini? (nömörö ti 0-9 kûê)

source_en: The numerator factorises as $(x-a)(x+a)$.
translation: Numérateur lingbi ti factoriser tongana $(x-a)(x+a)$.

source_en: Cancel, then put the limit value in place of x.
translation: Zîa ala so atîngbi, na pekoni zîa valeur ti limite na place ti x.

source_en: After factorising the numerator and cancelling, putting in x={a} gives {ans}.
translation: Na pekoni ti factorisation na simplification, tongana mo zîa x={a}, mo wara {ans}.
